_comment: Domain-neutral personas template. Copy to docs/user-manual/personas.json, then edit for your project. All fields except _comment are required. See SKILL.md section 1 + 5 for usage.
_granularity_help: One of: role_only | task_only | role_with_tasks (default). role_with_tasks generates the richest task cards.

personas.name: 运营人员
personas.description: 日常使用系统完成业务操作的一线人员,关注操作效率和准确率。
daily_tasks: 查询历史记录并导出报表
pain_points: 导出格式不兼容下游系统
personas._covers_objectives_help: List of business_objectives (from manual-config.json) this persona covers. Aggregate across all personas must span >= 2 distinct values, else validate-config fails.

personas.name: 业务专员
personas.description: 负责某个业务域的深度工作,有审批 / 配置权限,处理异常情况。
pain_points: 异常情况需要联系多个支持团队

personas.name: 业务主管
personas.description: 团队负责人,关注整体运营指标和下属工作进展,有查询和导出权限。

personas.name: 审计 / 合规人员
personas.description: 只读访问,需要导出全量数据进行审计,关注操作日志。
daily_tasks: 导出审计期间的全量数据
pain_points: 导出数据缺少关键字段

personas.name: 外部协作者
personas.description: 外聘律师 / 供应商接口人 / 审计机构等,通常只有部分数据的只读权限。
daily_tasks: 查看授权范围内的数据
pain_points: 提交材料格式有特殊要求

_validation_rules: each persona must have id, name, daily_tasks (>= 1 entry)
aggregate covers_objectives across all personas must span >= 2 distinct values from manual-config.json business_objectives
persona.id must match role names extractable from code (extract-roles.py) when RBAC is enabled; otherwise validate-config warns
